CutScene.Text: It was a stormy wintry day when a messenger arrived at the castle, bearing news of war.
The northern fortresses were under attack. Orcs had swept down from the mountains ravaging everything in their path. A number of villages already lay in ruins.
Strangely, though, the Orcs seemed to have a purpose. It was as if they were searching for something…
Regardless of their motives, it was imperative that a force be put together immediately to stop this invasion.
